title: Indexing a program after concatenation
statement: Let $P_0$ and $R$ be finite lists of statements, and let $i$ be a natural number. If the entry at index $i$ of $R$ is a statement $b$, then the entry at index $|P_0|+i$ of $P_0\mathbin{++}R$ is $b$.
hypotheses_covered: The entry at index $i$ of $R$ is the statement $b$
